# Tech Operators

> A network of experienced industry executives and founders in Ireland who advise, connect and invest in ambitious Irish startups, to help them grow internationally. Not a fund; no fees.

## How founders can work with us
- [For startups](https://www.techoperators.ie/startups): advice, introductions and angel investment (pre-seed and seed)
- [Apply as a founder](https://www.techoperators.ie/apply)
- [Meitheal principles](https://www.techoperators.ie/meitheal-principles): a curated group of members advising on one specific challenge

## Members
- [Member directory](https://www.techoperators.ie/members/): searchable by skill, industry, stage and company, including who is open to mentoring and who angel invests

## About
- [Operating policy](https://www.techoperators.ie/operating-policy)
- [Apply for membership](https://www.techoperators.ie/membership)
